featured_reviews.review_text:
I had hired R J Electrician for rewiring of our apartment. Found him on google based on his reviews. Rakesh visited our place, understood our requirement and suggested the best possible solution to fit our TIME and BUDGET. Quotation was provided free of cost, it included diagrams of switch boards, circuit map and list of materials. He recommends customer to purchase materials on their own to avoid any misunderstanding which I think is a good practice.

Rakesh was transparent and honest throughout the work, proper bills of all the adhoc material and their cost.
Rakesh and his team (Aftab and Mustaqueem) were excellent at work. No unwanted waste of time in between, sincere and hard working.

Just explain your requirements carefully and clearly and the job is done. On some days they ensured to stay back and complete the work to meet our deadline. They cleaned all the mess after completion of the work without any extra cost.

Rakesh's labour/service charges are fair and very reasonable. Aparr from electrical work, Rakesh and his team also took care of some of our other drill and hang work which  usuallyfalls under carpenter scope but thanks to Rakesh we didn't have to find anyone else.
I recommend 100% for the job 👍🏼
